verdict.gold_reason: Article 36(4) exempts new battery storage facilities with a final investment decision until 4 July 2019 from the phase-out in paragraph 3 for their usual depreciation period. The conditions are: connected within two years, integrated into the distribution system, used only for reactive instantaneous restoration of network security, and not used to buy or sell electricity, including balancing. The reference answer matches this.
